title: parse_did_key: decode did:key to Ed25519 VerifyingKey
description:
What: Implement parse_did_key() in crates/reader/src/post/did_verify.rs to decode a did:key URI into an Ed25519 verifying key.

Algorithm:
1. pub fn parse_did_key(did_url: &str) -> Result<ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey, DidSigError>
2. Check did_url starts with 'did:key:' prefix. If not or if method is something else (did:web:, did:example:, etc.), return DidSigError::UnsupportedMethod(method)
3. Extract the multibase identifier: strip 'did:key:' prefix
4. Check first char is 'z' (base58btc multibase prefix). If not, return DidSigError::InvalidKeyEncoding('not base58btc multibase'.into())
5. Strip the 'z' prefix, decode remaining string with bs58::decode().into_vec(). On error return DidSigError::InvalidKeyEncoding(e.to_string())
6. Check decoded bytes length >= 2 and first two bytes are [0xed, 0x01] (multicodec Ed25519 verification key prefix). If not, return DidSigError::UnsupportedMethod('not Ed25519 did:key'.into())
7. Remaining bytes (after 2-byte multicodec prefix) must be exactly 32 bytes. If not, return DidSigError::InvalidKeyEncoding('expected 32-byte key'.into())
8. Convert to [u8; 32], call ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes).map_err(|e| DidSigError::InvalidKeyEncoding(e.to_string()))
9. Return Ok(verifying_key)

Defensive programming:
- Reject any DID method other than did:key with UnsupportedMethod (did:web deferred to v2 to avoid SSRF)
- Validate multicodec prefix before trusting bytes as key material
- Do not log the key material itself in error messages
- ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey::from_bytes() validates the curve point; trust its error
